attribution: Assertions of the pinned manuscript, recorded as old Argus obligations; not independently established Argus results.

claim_versions.statement: Every fixed real gamma and finite-valued nonnegative psi with divergent sum phi(q)psi(q)/q have ||qx-gamma||<psi(q) infinitely often for almost every x.
claim_versions.concrete_gap: No complete construction, all-input verification or almost-everywhere tail reduction follows from the finite transport and remaining-comparison certificates.

claim_versions.statement: A static low-modulus additional birth test with arbitrarily small relative loss exists, total broad first-sharing counts are O(1), and narrow new-cell counts including newborn self/diagonal contributions are O(W)+O_k0(W^(1+c)), uniformly without N_0 dependence.
claim_versions.concrete_gap: The direct simultaneous-birth branch and existence/loss bound of its static additional test are excluded from RFJ.

claim_versions.statement: Direct adjacent simultaneous-birth broad and narrow bounds and the prescribed small-loss static additional birth test hold for stipulated retained data and fixed hierarchy.
claim_versions.concrete_gap: Neither the direct initial count nor the small-loss static selection rule is a conclusion of BC or RFJ.

claim_versions.statement: An equivariant exceptional selection exists and all three sparse-alignment weighted sums in tab:sparse-input are uniformly bounded over allowed prior histories, steps, masks and locations.
claim_versions.concrete_gap: The exceptional selection and all-step actual-success/pre-prime/exceptional weighted sums are not implied by an epoch-only first-join bound or column capacities.

claim_versions.statement: Chronological cells/classes exist with core equivariance, spans, padding, unsplit inheritance, old-child compatibility, clipping cap and arbitrarily small non-clipping first-mass losses.
claim_versions.concrete_gap: Conditional estimates on admissible histories do not prove their existence or construction losses; clipping control alone does not establish the remaining properties.

claim_versions.statement: Centre/birth selections and the three quantitative inputs imply a complete finite construction and almost-everywhere approximation through the finite-block reduction.
claim_versions.concrete_gap: Virtual-to-real first mass, cumulative soft/non-soft losses, energy control and the positive-measure-tail contradiction have not been certified by these draft units.

decisive_boundary: For-all-admissible-histories estimates do not establish existence, loss control, omitted comparison classes or the complete limiting reduction.
